name: Vents / flare tip
description: Flare and vent systems dispose of relief/blowdown/start-up gas by controlled combustion; a knock-out drum upstream removes entrained liquid to prevent liquid carryover, flame instability and hazardous 'flaming rain' (CRA Energy page, read). FlareTech states its knockout drums range from 2 to 600 barrels. The claim that cold vent is common on unmanned WHPs is not supported by a page read in this sweep and is left as a gap.
aliases: Vents / flare tip (cold vent common on unmanned WHPs)
